title: ROS 2 "module 'em' has no attribute 'BUFFERED_OPT'" and "No module named 'em'": colcon building interfaces with a venv Python, measured
excerpt: Why rosidl_generate_interfaces fails when CMake picks your venv Python: empy 4 on Humble, missing em, catkin_pkg, lark, numpy and setuptools, which fixes worked (deactivate, empy==3.3.4, both Python executable flags), and why ament_python packages can't hold messages. Humble, Jazzy, Lyrical.
